name: Shinsou Makou Shoujo Risve & Lyza ~Katou na Shokushu ni Okasareru Futari no Touki~
original_name: 神装魔光少女リズヴェ&ライザ ～下等な触手に犯される二人の闘姫～
source:
An assault persecution novel about impetuous fervent tentacles.
The heroines' pride gets writhed away little by strokey little. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE107732.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一部關於狂暴、灼熱的觸手襲擊女主角的文字冒險作品。
女主角們的自尊心一點一點地被削弱。
